answer: Sybil resistance begins with a per-identity stake bonded to a verifiable delay spiral that forces each new agent to traverse sequential proof-of-work epochs before voting weight activates. Each identity then commits a distinct cipher commitment binding its stake to hardware attestation, so a comet of ephemeral identities cannot cheaply replicate the costly delay path. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
